sections.content_markdown: 3. During summer vacation, Nusrat visited Sajek with her family. To hear an echo she screamed loudly beside a hill. But, hearing no echo, she felt sad. Then her father told Nusrat to move $3\text{ m}$ and to make a sound. This time Nusrat heard the echo. On that day, the velocity and frequency of sound was $332\text{ m/s}$ and $1328\text{ Hz}$.
(b) Why is a minimum distance necessary to hear an echo?
(c) What is the wavelength of sound produced by Nusrat?
(d) How far does Nusrat have to move backward if she wants to hear an echo after $0.3\text{ s}$ of screaming?
